items.question: What happens when a file contains no Feature line (empty, or only comments and blank lines)?
items.ticket: raise a clear error on invalid files
items.chose: Throws a ParseError reported at line 1.
items.instead: Return an empty feature, or report the error at the last line of the file.

items.question: Are Scenario Outline and Scenario Template accepted?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError saying 'Scenario Outline:' is not supported, at the outline line. Scenario Template is rejected with the same message.
items.instead: Parse outlines as scenarios, with their Examples tables.

items.question: Is `Example:` accepted as a scenario keyword?
How are tags handled, and which ones attach to the scenario?
items.chose: Collects every @ line into a pending list, splits it on whitespace, and attaches the list to the next Scenario. Tags before Feature or Background are discarded, and a tag line is never an error.
items.instead: Ignore tags, or error on tags before Feature or Background.

items.question: Does the parser support a Background section, and what does a Background with no steps return?
items.chose: Returns the background steps in a separate field, or an empty array for an empty Background. Returns null when there is no Background. A second Background, or one after a scenario, throws.
items.instead: Prepend background steps to each scenario, or ignore Background.

items.question: What happens to a step that appears before any Background or Scenario?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at the step's line.
items.instead: Treat the line as description text and ignore it.

items.question: What happens to an unrecognised line inside a scenario or background?
items.ticket: Invalid files report the line of the error
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at that line. In the header section (after Feature, before any Background or Scenario), unrecognised lines are silently accepted as description.
items.instead: Ignore free text everywhere, or reject free text in the header too.

items.question: Are doc strings and data tables supported, and how are they returned?
items.ticket: return scenarios with their steps and line numbers
items.chose: Attaches a doc string (an array of lines with the opening indent stripped) or a table (an array of rows with trimmed cells and \| \\ \n escapes) to the preceding step. Both `"""` and ``` delimiters are accepted.
items.instead: Ignore or reject doc strings and tables, or return doc strings as a single string joined with newlines.

items.question: At which line is an unclosed doc string reported?
items.ticket: Invalid files report the line of the error
items.chose: Reports the line that opened the doc string.
items.instead: Report the last line of the file, where the closing delimiter was expected.

items.question: What happens on a second Feature line?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at the second Feature line.
items.instead: Ignore it or treat it as a new feature.

items.question: How are CRLF line endings and a byte order mark handled?
items.chose: Strips a leading BOM and splits lines on \r?\n.
items.instead: Reject a BOM, or split only on \n and leave a trailing \r on each line.

items.question: How are keywords matched against text that merely starts like one, and what about a Scenario with no steps or a duplicate name?
items.chose: A step needs a keyword followed by whitespace and text, so 'Andrew' is not a step. A scenario with no steps is allowed and returns an empty list. Duplicate scenario names are not checked.
items.instead: Match keywords by prefix only, or reject empty and duplicate scenarios.
